page_title: SHU 1-4 BUR | Sheffield Utd v Burnley 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Sheffield Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+4' A tremendous drive by Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Ivo Grbic makes a brilliant save.

90+1' Wasted opportunity. Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
90+1' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+1' Sheffield Utd quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+1' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Sheffield Utd earn a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
86' Anthony Taylor blows the whistle, Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) is penalised for a foul.
85' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Wilson Odobert will be replaced by Zeki Amdouni (Burnley).
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and David Datro Fofana (Burnley) will replace Lyle Foster.
83' Lyle Foster (Burnley) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
81' The resulting set piece from Sheffield Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
78' Chris Wilder has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) replacing Oliver McBurnie.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) replaces Gustavo Hamer.
76' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
75' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post.

71' 1 - 4 Goal! Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
70' Substitution. Vitinho will be replaced by Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley).
68' Chris Wilder prepares a substitution. Vini Souza is replaced by Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd).
68' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
67' Vitinho (Burnley) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the top right corner, but Ivo Grbic is alert and denies him.

66' Lyle Foster (Burnley) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Burnley will have a chance to score from a corner.
65' Vitinho (Burnley) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
64' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) gets to the ball swung in from the corner and plants a close-range header low towards goal, but it's blocked then cleared away.
64' Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
63' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
62' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) causes Arijanet Muric little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.

61' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Lorenz Assignon (Burnley). Anthony Taylor saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Sheffield Utd have a free kick from a promising distance.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Josh Brownhill (Burnley) comes onto the pitch so that Jacob Bruun Larsen can be given a rest.
58' 1 - 3 Goal! Lorenz Assignon plays a pass to the feet of Lyle Foster (Burnley), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 1:3.
56' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
56' It will be a corner kick for Sheffield Utd.
54' A loose ball is pounced on by Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Ivo Grbic is alert and makes a comfortable save.

52' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! James McAtee slips the ball through to Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot inside the right post. He makes it 1:2.
50' Sheffield Utd fail to score from a corner as Arijanet Muric (Burnley) leaps to collect the ball.

49' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the top left corner, but Arijanet Muric makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sheffield Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
48' A cross from Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Now Sheffield Utd have a corner.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Lyle Foster (Burnley) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' 8:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
40' 0 - 2 Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Ivo Grbic with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
38' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Ivo Grbic. He makes it 0:1.
37' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Arijanet Muric easily deals with the threat.
36' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Arijanet Muric, who smothers the ball.
36' A quickly taken corner by Sheffield Utd.
34' Sheffield Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Sheffield Utd will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

34' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Sheffield Utd will have a corner.
33' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
32' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner which is cleared.
32' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd). Sheffield Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
31' Lyle Foster (Burnley) attempts to convert a cross into goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the top left corner is denied by a decent save from Ivo Grbic.

27' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
27' Good work from Sheffield Utd as they win a corner.
25' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Lyle Foster (Burnley) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Ivo Grbic is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
20' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
19' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Burnley are awarded a corner kick.

19' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Arijanet Muric anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.

18' A cross by Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
17' An attempted cross from Charlie Taylor (Burnley) is cleared.

16' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the top left corner. Arijanet Muric shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
15' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) trips an opposition player and Anthony Taylor signals a foul.
12' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
11' Lyle Foster (Burnley) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.

8' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Arijanet Muric, who pulls off a decent save!
7' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
6' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Burnley will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Anthony Taylor.
